# TopVolk Construction LLC

> Licensed and insured general contractor operating in Washington State, serving the greater Seattle area. We design and build kitchen remodels, bathroom renovations, decks, basement finishes, ADUs and full home additions, and provide the trades around them — framing, roofing, siding, plumbing, electrical, HVAC, tile, flooring and painting.

- Phone: (206) 591-1096
- Email: info@topvolk.org
- Hours: Mon-Sat 9:00 AM - 5:00 PM (Pacific Time)
- Founded: 2023
- 100+ completed residential projects
- 4.9 Google rating, 32 reviews
- Free estimates, upfront pricing

## Core Services

- [General Contracting](https://www.topvolk.org/services/general-contracting): full-service residential project management, permits, budget planning
- [Kitchen Remodel](https://www.topvolk.org/services/kitchen-remodel): cabinets, countertops, appliances, layout, backsplash
- [Bathroom Remodel](https://www.topvolk.org/services/bathroom-remodel): tile, vanities, fixtures, plumbing updates, layout changes
- [Home Additions](https://www.topvolk.org/services/home-additions): room additions, second-story builds
- [ADU Construction](https://www.topvolk.org/services/adu-construction): detached and attached accessory dwelling units
- [Basement Finishing](https://www.topvolk.org/services/basement-finishing): framing, insulation, drywall, flooring, waterproofing
- [Deck Installation](https://www.topvolk.org/services/deck-installation): composite, cedar, pressure-treated; railings, pergolas, custom designs
- [Garage Construction](https://www.topvolk.org/services/garage-construction): detached and attached garages

## Service Area

Core service area: King, Snohomish and Pierce counties in Washington — Seattle, Bellevue, Kirkland, Redmond, Renton, Tacoma, Everett and surrounding communities.

Full published coverage, city by city: [Service Areas](https://www.topvolk.org/service-areas)

## Specialties for Pacific Northwest Conditions

- Basement waterproofing for high-rainfall conditions
- Deck materials chosen for Pacific Northwest moisture (composite, cedar, pressure-treated)
- Permit-driven projects in King County, Snohomish County and City of Seattle SDCI
- Craftsman, mid-century and modern home renovations
